user.title: Welcome
user.description:
This integration shows your car's data in Home Assistant: battery, range, doors, tyre pressure, location and more. The data comes from the official Pleos interface of Hyundai, Kia and Genesis.

**Controlling the car is not possible this way** – the interface only provides data.

Which brand is your car?

data_description.brand: If you have cars of several brands, simply set up the integration once per brand. Each brand needs its own key.

key_menu.title: API key
key_menu.description:
To connect you need a free, personal API key for {brand}. It consists of a **Client ID** and a **Client Secret**.

Do you already have one?

menu_options.guide: No, show me how to get it

guide.title: How to get the key
guide.description:
This takes about 5 minutes:

1. [Open Pleos Playground]({url}) and sign up for free.
2. Tap the **person icon** in the top right and choose **My Vehicle Data API**.
3. Choose the **{brand}** tab, tick both terms and press **Get API Key**.
4. In the new window, sign in with your **{account}** app credentials (the same as in the app on your phone).
5. Copy **Client ID** and **Client Secret** and press **Submit** here.

Important:
- This only works in Europe.
- The key only contains cars that are **already in the app**. If you add a car later, get a new key.

credentials.title: Enter the key
credentials.description: Copy both values from the **My Vehicle Data API** page ({brand}). After submitting, the integration checks the key right away and looks for your cars.

data_description.client_id: Shown in the Playground under My Vehicle Data API › {brand}. Best use the copy button.
data_description.client_secret: The secret part of the key. It is hidden and only stored in Home Assistant.

vehicles.title: Your cars
vehicles.description:
Found: {count} car(s). Tick the ones you want to add and give each a name.

**All entities of the car are named after it** (e.g. `sensor.<name>_ev_battery_level`). The name from the app is pre-filled.

Did you use **Hyundai / Kia Connect** before? Then use the same name as there – your automations and dashboards keep working.

data_description.selected: The label shows the model and the last 4 characters of the VIN.
data_description.scan_interval: In minutes. The car only reports now and then; 10 minutes is usually fine.

migrate.title: Take over old entities?
migrate.description:
There are still entities from **Hyundai / Kia Connect** for {names}.

If you take them over, the new entities get exactly the same entity IDs. **History, automations and dashboards are kept.** The old entries are replaced.

Switches, buttons and the lock are not available here, because the Pleos interface only provides data.

Tip: Remove the old Hyundai / Kia Connect integration afterwards so it does not create duplicate entities.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew the key
reauth_confirm.description:
The API key for **{title}** is no longer valid – it was revoked, reissued or has expired.

How to get a new one:
1. [Open Pleos Playground]({url}) and sign in.
2. Person icon › **My Vehicle Data API** › **{brand}** tab.
3. If needed press **Get API Key** and sign in with your {account} account.
4. Enter Client ID and Client Secret here.

data_description.client_id: Shown in the Playground under My Vehicle Data API › {brand}.
data_description.client_secret: The secret part of the key.

reconfigure.title: Change settings
reconfigure.description: What would you like to change for **{title}**?

add_vehicle.title: Add a new car
add_vehicle.description:
A key only contains the cars that were in the app when it was issued. A new car therefore needs a new key:

1. Add the car in the **{account}** app.
2. [Open Pleos Playground]({url}) › person icon › **My Vehicle Data API** › **{brand}** tab.
3. Press **Revoke API Key** and confirm (the old key stops working).
4. Press **Get API Key** and sign in with your {account} account.
5. Press **Submit** and enter the new values.

Your existing cars and entities stay unchanged.

add_credentials.title: Enter the new key
add_credentials.description: Enter the new key. Afterwards the integration only shows the **newly added** cars for naming.

data_description.client_id: The new Client ID from My Vehicle Data API › {brand}.

change_key.title: Change the key
change_key.description: Enter a new key for the same cars, e.g. after revoking the old one in the [Pleos Playground]({url}).

data_description.client_id: Shown in the Playground under My Vehicle Data API › {brand}.
data_description.client_secret: The secret part of the key.

rename.title: Rename cars
rename.description: A new name changes the car's display name. Existing entity IDs stay the same so automations keep working.

data_description.scan_interval: In minutes. 10 minutes is usually fine.

error.invalid_auth: Client ID or Client Secret is wrong. Please copy both values again without spaces. If the key was revoked, get a new one in the Playground.
error.no_vehicles: The key does not contain any car. Is the car in the app? Was the key issued after that? Otherwise revoke the key in Playground › My Vehicle Data API, get a new one and enter it here.
error.no_new_vehicles: This key does not contain a new car. Is the car already in the app? Then revoke the key in the Playground and get a new one.
error.other_vehicles: This key does not contain any of the configured cars. Did you choose the right brand and account?
error.cannot_connect: Pleos cannot be reached right now. Please check the internet connection and try again later.
error.no_selection: Please tick at least one car.
error.unknown: Unexpected answer from Pleos. Please try again later.

abort.already_configured: This key is already set up. You find it under Settings › Devices & services.
abort.reauth_successful: The new key works. Data is being fetched again.
abort.vehicle_added: The new car has been added.

init.title: Cars and interval
init.description:
A new name changes the car's display name. Existing entity IDs stay the same so automations keep working.

New car or new key? Choose **Reconfigure** in the integration's three-dot menu.

data_description.scan_interval: In minutes. 10 minutes is usually fine.

auth_failed.title: The API key for {brand} is no longer valid
auth_failed.description:
{title} no longer receives data because the key was revoked, reissued or has expired.

Go to **Settings › Devices & services**, open Hyundai Kia Genesis (Pleos) and press **Reauthenticate** on the notice. It explains how to get a new key.

vehicle_removed.title: Car {name} no longer in the key

confirm.title: Remove car {name}?
confirm.description:
The car {name} (VIN ending in {vin_end}) is no longer part of the API key, e.g. because it was sold or removed from the app. No more data arrives.

Press **Submit** to remove the car and its entities from Home Assistant. If the car is still yours, get a new key in the Pleos Playground instead.

update_failed.message: Pleos did not return any data.

vehicle_removed.message: The car is no longer part of the API key.
